audit.why: Melee duelist who scales past you. Aatrox owns levels 1-5; Jax takes over at 6 and hard on items, matching the existing chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase text was a generic template that named no ultimate and no cooldown.
audit.why: Grandmaster-at-Arms (R) is 110/100/90, giving him resistances and a third-hit magic burst. World Ender (120/100/80) is comparable, so the fight is decided by Counter Strike, not by ults.
audit.corrected: Grandmaster-at-Arms (R) gives him resistances and a third-hit burst on 110s. Never open into Counter Strike (E, 17s at rank 1) — bait the dodge, then commit World Ender.

audit.why: Counter Strike (E, 17/15/13/11/9) dodges all incoming attacks then stuns — it eats your autos and your Q3 knock-up. Leap Strike (Q, 8/7.5/7/6.5/6) and Empower (W) are both dash-flagged, so Infernal Chains grounds his stick.

edits.before: Ultimate interaction changes all-ins. At level 6, reassess the matchup. Aatrox gains his ultimate, but Jax's ultimate or scaling pattern may change whether you can commit.
